children: Tokyo, August 31, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has affirmed AGC Inc.' s A2 issuer rating and maintained the stable outlook. We have also affirmed the Prime-1 backed commercial paper rating of AGC Capital, Inc., a subsidiary of AGC. title: Moody's Ratings affirms AGC's A2 rating; outlook stable
